use_case_summary: Real-time customer chat with strict latency SLOs + high-qps reranking for trade alerts. Nightly bulk embeddings for analytics. Cost sensitivity for steady-state, but must handle short high-frequency bursts at market open/close.
technical_requirements: Latency: chat p99 <= 120ms for short-session flows (8–12 turns)
Throughput: baseline steady qps ~180, observed peak burst qps ~1800 (10x for 30–45s)
Token throughput: average 12 tokens/request -> steady ~2,160 tokens/sec, peak ~21,600 tokens/sec
Model preferences: quantized Llama-3 class models or small Falcon variants; open to Redwood-verified variants
Fallback routing: route to lower-cost quantized model or GPU pool within 200ms added latency
Security: VPC private deployment w/ customer KMS/HSM, audit-logging retention 7 years, SOC2/ISO evidence required
workshop_outcomes: Validated bursty traffic pattern — short, high-amplitude spikes at market open/close
Recommended prefix-KV caching for repeated prompt fragments in chat to reduce token load
Identified embeddings jobs can be scheduled to off-peak for cost savings; no strong latency requirement
SE to produce three sizing options (steady, burst-tolerant with reserved burst pool, enterprise SLA + on-call)
recommended_sizing: Option A (steady): support 180 qps steady; estimated reserved: 4x A100-80GB equivalent; expected ARR bracket: lower tier

Option B (burst-ready): steady 180 qps + capacity buffer for 10x bursts to 1800 qps for 45s via autoscale + reserved burst pool; estimated reserved: 8x H100 equivalent + burst credits; cost higher, SLA p99 target achievable
Option C (enterprise): hard throughput guarantee for peak windows, dedicated private cluster in VPC, 12-mo commit, HSM integration; estimated reserved: 12x H100 + dedicated networking and on-call SLA
sla_items: Performance SLOs: p99 latency target for chat routes; credit/backout for sustained misses
Burst guarantee: documented burst pool behavior and failover to lower-cost model with graceful degradation
Security addendum: KMS/HSM clauses, audit log exports, incident response time (P1 within 30m)
Data residency: logs and KV cache controls to satisfy EU/NA residency requests
